title: Defeating MAGA Is Only Half Done
summary: The G.O.P. has not learned its lesson.

The Republican Party has not learned its lesson.


Consider what’s happened since Nov. 3, when it faced the largest midterm electoral rebuke that any party has received since at least 1974.


President Trump[elevated Stephen Miller](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/06/us/trump-miller-wiles-chief-of-staff) to chief of staff, the man who is more responsible than any other person aside from Trump for the brutal immigration crackdown that may have alienated Hispanic voters for a generation.


House Republicans made Jim Jordan of Ohio the new minority leader. Jordan, for those who don’t follow these things closely, is one of the most pugilistic MAGA hatchet men in Congress, a “[backroom brawler](https://www.cleveland.com/open/2026/11/house-republicans-turn-to-jim-jordan-you-need-a-guy-thats-a-backroom-brawler.html) ,” in the words of an Ohio Republican operative named Bob Kish. As The Columbus Dispatch[observed](https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/2026/11/11/jim-jordan-house-republican-leader-career-bio-ohio-washington-dc/92723318007/) , “In nearly 20 years in Congress, Jordan has not been the lead sponsor of a bill that became law.”


He is, however, a[fixture on Fox News](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-caucus-new-house-gop-leader-jim-jordan-has-made-least-716-weekday-appearances-fox#:~:text=MAHA%20advocates%20celebrate%20Susie%20Wiles'%20ousting%2C%20welcoming,Fox%20since%202017.%2011%2F10%2F26%204%3A07%20PM%20EST.) .


The[White House](https://punchbowl.news/wh-hill_letter/?utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11/11/26%20AM:&utm_term=%28prod%29%20AM%20Subscribers) and the[Department of Justice](https://x.com/USAttyReitz/status/2120632462686711838?s=20) have threatened Democrats with legal consequences if they investigate the rampant corruption endemic to the Trump administration. The very idea is preposterous.[As the Supreme Court explained](https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/273/135/) almost 100 years ago, “the power of inquiry — with process to enforce it — is an essential and appropriate auxiliary to the legislative function.”


House Republicans[wrapped both arms](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/10/us/hegseth-impeachment-vote-house) around Pete Hegseth, protecting him from impeachment (for now), even though he has[violated the Constitution](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/opinion/pete-hegseth-impeach-congress.html) , violated the laws of armed conflict and helped plan and execute a blatantly unconstitutional war against Iran.


But perhaps nothing sums up the state of the Republican Party better than the report that Trump[tried to stop](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/politics/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia.html) Jensen Huang from stepping down as the chief executive of Nvidia, even as reports of multiple deeply troublesome affairs emerged, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
